title: What If You Drank Nothing but Seawater?

scenes.text: What if you drank nothing but seawater? It would leave you thirstier than when you started.
Seawater is about three and a half percent salt, more than three times saltier than your blood.
Your kidneys can't make urine saltier than seawater. So getting rid of the salt costs more water than you drank.
Flushing the salt from just one cup takes at least a cup of fresh water. You end up further behind.
Your cells take on more salt than they can handle, and the thirst only grows. NOAA says it can be deadly.
Seabirds have salt glands, and marine mammals have cells that purge salt. We have neither. The ocean can't be our drink.
